template.name: Daily Range
template.notes: The documented SlidingWindowDays of 3 becomes a three-bar high/low range and the OffsetCoefficient of 1 percent is applied to the breakout levels; RangeMode, the 10:05 session reset and MaxPositionsPerDay=3 are calendar or order-count fields. StopLossCoefficient 0.03 and TakeProfitCoefficient 0.05 scale with the range and are not fixed percentages.
